class: A page's shape (two password boxes) outranked what the page says about them (optional)
symptom: Meta, 30 September: the application page ends with 'Create a Career Profile account (optional)' -- Password / Confirm password, 'the system will create your account after you submit'. The agent took the whole page for a new-account form, tried to create the account ('no Create Account button found'), then stopped for the owner twice: 'the new-account form is still showing after the account was created' -- Continue and Resume both led back to it.
site: Meta careers; any application form with an optional account section
root_cause: account_state.read_state made any page with two password boxes a CREATE_FORM, without reading the section's own heading saying the account is optional.
why_tests_missed: Account tests used pages that are only an account form; none had an optional account section under the application.
fix: A heading that says the account it offers is optional makes the page NONE (the application): no account is created, its password boxes stay empty, and the agent goes on with the form.
prevention: What the page says about a section (optional, required, already done) decides before the section's shape does.
